technical_analysis: We vet nearshore Node.js developers by tasking them with optimizing a service that exhibits event loop blocking under load. The candidate must use tools like clinic.js to identify the blocking code and refactor it into non-blocking, asynchronous patterns. Success requires not only fixing the immediate issue but also implementing proper stream backpressure handling to prevent memory exhaustion. We expect our nearshore Node.js developers to articulate the trade-offs between different ORMs like Prisma and TypeORM in the context of connection pooling and query performance. The final solution must meet a p95 latency SLO of under 150ms. This rigorous process guarantees the nearshore Node.js developers you hire can build resilient, high-performance backends.
